<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 Z" fill="#c2410c" stroke="#c2410c"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="1000" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="500" y="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="23" fill="#172033">Unit square plate — prescribed heat fluxes</text>
  <text x="500" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#374151">k = 1 W/(m K) · No internal heat generation</text>

  <!-- Exact plate mapping: X = 100 + 800x; Y = 900 - 800y. -->
  <rect x="100" y="100" width="800" height="800" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#172033" stroke-width="3"/>

  <text x="500" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#374151">Insulated: q · n = 0</text>
  <text x="500" y="932" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#374151">Insulated: q · n = 0</text>

  <g fill="none" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <line x1="45" y1="280" x2="99" y2="280"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="420" x2="99" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="560" x2="99" y2="560"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="700" x2="99" y2="700"/>
    <line x1="901" y1="280" x2="955" y2="280"/>
    <line x1="901" y1="420" x2="955" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="901" y1="560" x2="955" y2="560"/>
    <line x1="901" y1="700" x2="955" y2="700"/>
  </g>

  <text x="25" y="500" transform="rotate(-90 25 500)" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#c2410c">200 W/m² into plate</text>
  <text x="980" y="500" transform="rotate(90 980 500)" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#c2410c">100 W/m² out of plate</text>

  <text x="116" y="128" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#374151">(0, 1)</text>
  <text x="884" y="128" text-anchor="end" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#374151">(1, 1)</text>
  <text x="116" y="881" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#374151">(0, 0)</text>
  <text x="884" y="881" text-anchor="end" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#374151">(1, 0)</text>

  <text x="500" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#991b1b">No steady-state solution</text>
  <text x="500" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#172033">Steady conduction without generation requires</text>
  <text x="500" y="372" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="23" fill="#172033">∮ q · n ds = 0, with q = −k ∇T.</text>
  <text x="500" y="417" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#172033">Specified outward flux integral: −200 + 100 = −100 W/m.</text>
  <text x="500" y="451" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b">Net heat input is 100 W per metre of plate depth.</text>
  <text x="500" y="493" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#374151">The boundary conditions violate steady energy conservation.</text>

  <!-- Empty paths intentionally encode unavailable levels, not invented contours.
       No isotherm geometry can satisfy these incompatible boundary conditions. -->
  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <path data-level="20" d="" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="500" y="562" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#475569">20 °C isotherm — undefined</text>
  </g>
  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <path data-level="40" d="" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="500" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#475569">40 °C isotherm — undefined</text>
  </g>
  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <path data-level="60" d="" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="500" y="638" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#475569">60 °C isotherm — undefined</text>
  </g>
  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <path data-level="80" d="" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="500" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#475569">80 °C isotherm — undefined</text>
  </g>

  <text x="500" y="745" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#374151">No contours drawn: an exact steady temperature field does not exist.</text>

  <line x1="100" y1="960" x2="900" y2="960" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="950" x2="100" y2="970" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="900" y1="950" x2="900" y2="970" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="500" y="987" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#374151">Width = 1 m · Height = 1 m</text>
</svg>
